subject: microbiology
title: Clostridium botulinum, Botulism and Clostridioides difficile

steps.tx: **Clostridium botulinum** is an anaerobic spore former whose botulinum neurotoxins (types A to G, proteases cleaving SNARE fusion proteins at cholinergic terminals) cause flaccid paralysis: foodborne (preformed toxin in canned and fermented foods), infant (gut colonisation from honey and dust), wound, iatrogenic and inhalational forms, symmetric descending weakness with autonomic dryness and clear mind.
steps.say: Descending flaccid paralysis, dry mouth, clear sensorium: botulism until excluded.

left.title: Botulism portrait
points: Cranial nerves first: diplopia, ptosis, dysarthria
Dry mouth, ileus, urinary retention, dilated pupils variable

steps.tx: **Clostridium botulinum** is an anaerobic spore former. Its neurotoxins, types A to G, are proteases that cleave SNARE fusion proteins at cholinergic nerve endings and cause flaccid paralysis. Foodborne disease follows preformed toxin in canned or fermented food. Infants can be colonised from honey or dust. Wound, iatrogenic, and inhalational forms also exist. The pattern is symmetric descending weakness, dry autonomic signs, and a clear mind.
steps.say: Botulinum toxins cleave SNARE proteins at cholinergic endings and produce flaccid paralysis. Sources include canned food, infant gut colonisation from honey or dust, wounds, injections, and inhalation. Weakness descends symmetrically, the mouth is dry, and the mind stays clear.

vis.alt: A diagram of a patient shows descending flaccid weakness from the cranial nerves down the limbs, with alertness preserved.
vis.caption: Descending flaccid weakness starts at the cranial nerves while alertness stays intact, the bedside map of botulism. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: **Botulinum toxin mechanism** mirrors tetanus backwards: light chain proteases cleave SNAP25, syntaxin or VAMP at peripheral cholinergic synapses, acetylcholine vesicles cannot fuse, neuromuscular and autonomic transmission fails. Same enzyme family, different trafficking address, opposite clinical sign: spastic versus flaccid. Duration follows the toxin serotype, with type A generally producing longer paralysis than type E in foodborne outbreaks.
steps.say: Tetanus cuts brakes in the cord, botulinum cuts the accelerator at the muscle: flaccid wins.

left.title: SNARE targets
points: B, D, F, G: VAMP synaptobrevin
Recovery by terminal sprouting weeks to months

right.title: Mirror tetanus
points: Botulinum stays peripheral, tetanus retrograde central

steps.tx: **Botulism management** is antitoxin early (equine heptavalent BAT through public health, human BIG for infants) after specimens drawn but never delayed by them, airway and ventilation vigilance (vital capacity trending), no antibiotics needed in foodborne (aminoglycosides worsen block) except wound botulism debridement and penicillin traditions, immediate notification.
steps.say: Call public health for antitoxin before weakness reaches the diaphragm; aminoglycosides deepen the block.

steps.tx: **Infant botulism** colonises immature gut flora (honey the famous but minority source, soil dust majority): constipation first, poor feeding, weak cry, floppy baby with ptosis, descending hypotonia, human botulism immune globulin (BabyBIG) shortening hospital stay, antibiotics avoided (lysis may release toxin) and honey forbidden under twelve months by rule.
steps.say: Constipated, floppy, weak cry: infant botulism; no honey under one year is its public slogan.

left.title: Infant portrait
points: Poor suck, weak cry, head lag

steps.tx: **Foodborne botulism sources** (home canned low acid vegetables, fermented fish and marine foods, garlic oil, foil wrapped potatoes held warm) share anaerobic spore germination in preserved food, toxin odourless and tasteless often, boiling food ten minutes destroys toxin while spores demand pressure canning science (121 degrees schedules by food).
steps.say: Pressure can low acid food correctly or spores will can toxin instead.

left.title: Classic vehicles
points: Herb oils and baked potatoes held

right.title: Kitchen rules
points: Boil home canned foods 10 minutes before tasting traditions
Bulging cans discarded unopened or tasted never

steps.tx: **Clostridioides difficile** is the spore forming anaerobe of antibiotic disrupted gut: toxins A (enterotoxin) and B (cytotoxin) glucosylate Rho GTPases collapsing colonocyte cytoskeletons, pseudomembranous colitis, binary toxin in epidemic 027 strains, diagnosed by two step algorithms (GDH plus toxin, NAAT arbitration), never by NAAT alone in formed stool.
steps.say: Antibiotics clear the field, spores germinate, toxins melt the colon lining.

left.title: CDI portrait
points: Watery diarrhoea after antibiotics (clindamycin, cephalosporins, fluoroquinolones)

right.title: Testing discipline
points: GDH plus toxin EIA, NAAT arbitrates discordance
No test of cure, no repeat within days

steps.tx: **CDI therapy and recurrence** (fidaxomicin preferred where available, vancomycin oral standard, metronidazole legacy mild, bezlotoxumab monoclonal against toxin B in high recurrence risk, faecal microbiota and live biotherapeutics for multiple recurrences) plus spore infection control (soap, hypochlorite, isolation) complete the pharmacology module's debt.
steps.say: Treat the colon, spare the microbiome, wash spores off with soap: CDI in three clauses.

left.title: Treatment ladder
points: Fidaxomicin or oral vancomycin first line
Fulminant: vancomycin plus IV metronidazole, surgery consult
Bezlotoxumab adjunct in high recurrence risk

steps.tx: **Botulinum as medicine** (onabotulinum and kin at picogram doses) treats dystonia, spasticity, chronic migraine, hyperhidrosis and bladder overactivity by the same SNARE cleavage, adverse spread causing dysphagia and weakness, immunogenicity with frequent high doses, black box distant spread. Poison and drug differ by dose and address, Paracelsus in a vial.
steps.say: Picograms at the right muscle are therapy; micrograms in food are catastrophe.

left.title: Therapeutic map
points: Type A products, type B alternative
Antibody resistance with high frequent doses

right.title: Safety fences
points: Cosmetic: brow and lid ptosis temporary
